resources.string: This wallet is already on this phone and works. What you entered was not saved here before, so SORA saved it as this wallet\'s backup. You can see it in Account options. Nothing else was changed.
This account can\'t send from this phone. Restore its keys first.

The signing key saved for this account on this phone can\'t be used, so sending, swapping and other transactions are off for it. You can still receive, and see balances and history. To use it here again, restore its keys.
Sending, swapping and other transactions are off for this account, because its signing key on this phone can\'t be used. Restore its keys to use it here again.
You can still receive, and see balances and history. Your other accounts are not affected. Restoring the keys keeps this account, its name and its history.
Part of this account\'s signing key is missing on this phone.
No signing key for this account is saved on this phone.
SORA hasn\'t checked this account\'s signing key on this phone yet. The check runs each time SORA starts. Restoring the keys below also completes it.
The signing key saved for this account on this phone can\'t be used for its address.
The signing key saved for this account on this phone can\'t be read.
This account is watch-only. Its signing key was never saved on this phone.
The signing key saved for this account on this phone can\'t be used, so nothing was signed or sent. To use the account here again, open Account options and restore its keys.
These actions open Import account. Enter this account\'s recovery phrase, raw seed or backup file there, and SORA puts its keys back in place. You never need to remove the account to repair it.
Use a raw seed or backup file
Show the backup saved on this phone
This account can\'t send from this phone
Removing deletes this account\'s keys from this phone. Your funds stay on the blockchain, and the account can be added again later with its backup.

This is the only account on this phone. Removing it deletes its keys from this phone, and also your SORA PIN and your custom nodes. SORA then starts again from the welcome screen. Your funds stay on the blockchain.
I have the recovery phrases of those wallets, or I don\'t need them

%1$s of them can still be restored now with your SORA PIN, under Login & Security, Wallets found on this phone. This removal also removes the PIN. Afterwards only their own recovery phrases bring them back. If you don\'t have those phrases, keep this account and restore those wallets first.

SORA found no recovery phrase or raw seed on this phone that matches this account, so there is none to show. If you remove it, this phone can\'t bring it back. You would need a backup you made earlier.
This account still works here, so you can back it up now: export it as an encrypted JSON file. It can be brought back later from Import account, Backup file (JSON).
SORA checks everything before it removes an account, and a check didn\'t pass, so nothing was removed (%1$s). Please try again.
This account has a transaction that isn\'t finished yet, so it can\'t be removed now. Nothing was removed. Wait until the transaction shows as completed or failed in Activity, then try again.
Write down this recovery phrase first and keep it safe. After removal you need it, or another backup you made, to add this account again.
Tap the hidden part above to show it. You can tick this once it has been shown.
Write down this raw seed first and keep it safe. After removal you need it, or another backup you made, to add this account again.

Encrypted safety copies of wallet data that SORA may have made on this phone during an update or a repair. Removing an account does not erase them. They leave the phone only when SORA itself is uninstalled.
Wallet keys that no account uses, if any are saved on this phone. They are not removed. After this, each can only be restored here with its own recovery phrase.
Wallet keys that no account uses: %1$s found on this phone. They are not removed. After this, each can only be restored here with its own recovery phrase.
Your other accounts, your PIN and your settings.
Remove this account from this phone?
I understand that this phone can\'t bring this account back

What you entered belongs to an account that is already on this phone, but the keys saved for it here can\'t be used. SORA can replace them with the keys from what you entered. The account keeps its address, name and history, and your other accounts are not touched. A copy of the old keys stays on this phone.

The other accounts in this file were added or are already here. For the accounts below, keys are already saved on this phone, but they can\'t be used. SORA can replace them with the keys from this file. Each account keeps its address, and your other accounts are not touched. A copy of the old keys stays on this phone.

Keys for this wallet are already saved on this phone, but they can\'t be used. SORA can replace them with the keys from what you entered and add the wallet. Its address stays the same, and your other accounts are not touched. A copy of the old keys stays on this phone.
SORA couldn\'t keep a copy of the old keys first, for example because the phone is low on storage. Nothing was changed. Free some space and try again.
The PIN was wrong too many times, so PIN entry is locked for about %1$s min, here and on the PIN screen. Nothing was changed. After that, you can start again from Import account.
That PIN isn\'t right. Nothing was changed.
SORA can\'t read the PIN saved on this phone. Confirm with your phone\'s screen lock instead.
SORA can\'t read the PIN saved on this phone, and this phone has no screen lock to confirm with. Set a screen lock in your phone\'s settings, then start the repair again. Nothing was changed.
SORA can\'t read the PIN saved on this phone, so this repair has to be confirmed with your phone\'s screen lock. Nothing was changed. Start again from Import account.
Repair this account with its recovery phrase
Repair this account from your backup
Repair accounts from your backup file
This wallet can\'t be added here
This phone already holds different keys for this wallet, so nothing was changed. Your funds are safe on the blockchain. Please contact support.
Transfers you received may not be listed here yet. Your balance is not affected.
Turns off glow, glass and motion effects. Useful on older phones or to save battery.

No recovery phrase or seed saved on this phone matches this account, so none is shown. The account itself still works. To back it up, export it as an encrypted JSON file. You can bring it back later from Import account, Backup file (JSON).

No recovery phrase or seed saved on this phone matches this account, so none is shown. To use this account on this phone again, go to Import account and enter its recovery phrase, raw seed or backup file.
This account setup was interrupted before it was finished, so no account was created and nothing was saved. Please start again from Create account.
SORA couldn\'t save your new account on this phone just now, so it hasn\'t been added. Your recovery phrase is still shown on this screen. Keep it, then tap Continue to try again.
Your new account isn\'t saved yet
SORA couldn\'t prepare a new account just now. Nothing was created or changed. Please try again in a moment.
New accounts can\'t be added while SORA is in read-only mode. Nothing was created or changed. Go back to the wallet and choose Try upgrade again.
A new account can\'t be made right now

An account you chose can\'t be exported, because the keys saved for it on this phone can\'t be used. No file was made. To use that account on this phone again, go to Import account and enter its recovery phrase, raw seed or backup file.

These accounts can't be exported, because the keys saved for them on this phone can't be used:

%1$s

No file was made. Export your other accounts without them. To use these accounts on this phone again, go to Import account and enter their recovery phrase, raw seed or backup file.
In the next step SORA shows the passphrase saved on this phone that allows you to recover this account, if one matches it.
In the next step you will see the %1$s-word passphrase that allows you to recover the account.
SORA couldn\'t complete this just now. Please try again in a moment. If you were making a transaction, check Activity first, so that nothing is sent twice.
SORA passed this transaction to the network but couldn\'t confirm the result. It may still go through. Open Activity and wait a little before you try again, so that nothing is sent twice.
Check Activity before you try again

SORA couldn\'t restore this account from its Google backup: the backup data is damaged or belongs to another account. Nothing on this phone was changed. If you have the account\'s recovery phrase, raw seed or backup file, go to Import account and enter it.
Every account backed up in this Google account is already on this phone, so there is nothing to restore. To add another account, choose Create account or Import account.
This account is on this phone, but it can\'t send from here. To repair it, restore this backup.

Added %1$s of the accounts in this file. %2$s were not changed: other keys, which can\'t be used, are saved for them on this phone. To repair them, import this file again and confirm the repair, or go to Import account and enter an account\'s recovery phrase.
This isn\'t an encrypted account backup (JSON) that SORA can read. Check that you chose the file you exported, or pasted all of its text. Nothing was changed.
This backup file can\'t be read
That password doesn\'t open this backup file. Enter the password you chose when you exported it. Nothing was changed.

The SORA network was upgraded, and this version of the app can\'t prepare transactions for it yet. Please update the app to send, swap or claim. Your balances still update, and your funds are safe on the blockchain.
The network fee can\'t be checked right now. Try again in a moment. Your funds are safe on the blockchain.
The network fee can\'t be checked because the SORA network can\'t be reached right now. Check your internet connection and try again. Your funds are safe on the blockchain.
Your SORA Nexus production address is ready to copy. The production network has not launched yet; balances, history and transfers will be available after launch.
Sending is currently unavailable for this account. You can view your balance, copy your address and receive testnet XOR.

SORA found wallet keys on this phone that no account uses, for example after this device was set up again. Enter the PIN you used in SORA on this phone to restore these wallets. Nothing is deleted or changed if you leave this screen.
Keys of wallets you used here before are still on this phone. Restore them with your SORA PIN.
The PIN was wrong too many times, so PIN entry is locked for about %1$s min. Nothing was changed. You can still use Import account with a recovery phrase.
Restored %1$s of %2$s wallets. The others can\'t be restored from the keys on this phone. Import their recovery phrase or seed instead. Nothing was changed for them.
All wallets adds each wallet’s own total, with each wallet’s own hidden assets.
Polkaswap is available in this build
Polkaswap shows its disclaimer before your first swap
Shown in Send before you confirm
The total adds the full balance of every visible asset that has a price, on mainnet networks. Hidden, unpriced and testnet holdings are left out and named, never dropped silently.
Move works between your own wallets. Add another wallet to move funds between them.
Move needs another of your wallets with an account on %1$s.
Send shows the fee and the final amount. Nothing moves until you confirm there.
Sending on this network is not available for this wallet right now.
Nothing to list. Hidden assets are not shown here.
Nothing here can be moved right now.
Nothing on SORA2 to swap yet.
The SORA DEX. Swaps happen on SORA2, so the token has to be there.
There is no route from %1$s in this version.
On SORA2. Swap on Polkaswap now with your SORA2 account in %1$s.
Testnet assets have no monetary value.
Sample portfolio: addresses are invented, so this does not open Send.
Sending on %1$s is not available in this version.
Polkaswap shows price, fee and impact before you sign. This only picks the pair.
Could not switch wallets. Nothing was changed.
This is in %1$s. We switch to it first.
Every wallet is up to date.
You are offline. Balances are the last ones saved on this device, so the total may be out of date.
%1$s could not be reached. Its balances are left out until it answers.
Some balances are older than the rest. The list says how old each wallet is.
This token is no longer in this view.
Receive tokens to this wallet. They show up here, on every network this app supports.
All wallets adds each wallet’s own total. Wallets that are not selected keep their last sync, so the list says how old each one is.
Restore an account from a backup file you previously saved. Choose the JSON file below, or paste its contents.
SORA couldn\'t read that file. Choose the JSON file you exported from SORA. Nothing was changed.
This phone has no app for choosing a file. Paste the text of your backup file into the field instead. Nothing was changed.
Enter the password you set when saving this backup. This is not your app PIN.
SORA couldn\'t read just now which wallets may be shown, so some may be missing from this list. Go back and try again.
Wallet keys that were on this phone before the current SORA PIN was set are not listed here. Their recovery phrase can\'t be shown after this confirmation.
SORA is checking your account before opening the wallet. Your keys stay on this device.
Your wallet won\'t move to a new phone automatically. Keep your recovery phrase or a Google Drive backup.
Picking up where we left off. Your keys stay on this device.
Please don\'t uninstall SORA or clear its storage. Your keys are stored on this device.
Keep SORA open and installed until this finishes.
This makes your wallet harder to guess. Your wallet and funds don\'t change.
A previous transaction is still being checked. Sending is paused so nothing is sent twice.
You can view balances and history. Sending is off until the upgrade finishes.

SORA couldn\'t finish checking your wallet after the update, so it opened in read-only mode. Sending, swapping and account changes are off until the check finishes. Your keys and accounts were not changed.
Sending is off in read-only mode
SORA found wallet keys on this phone that no account uses, for example from an account setup that was not finished. They were kept and nothing was deleted. You can restore them here.

This wallet\'s keys were on this phone before your current SORA PIN was set, so the PIN can\'t restore it. To bring it back, import its recovery phrase, raw seed or backup file. The keys saved here are then used as they are.
This wallet can\'t be restored from the keys on this phone. Import its recovery phrase or seed instead.
Restored. It is now in your accounts.
Make sure no one can see your screen.
Still working… this can take up to a minute on some devices.
No email app is set up. You can write to %1$s.
Your keys stay on this device. This usually takes under a minute.
We\'ll continue as soon as you\'re back online.
Your accounts are on this device
Accounts that can send from this phone: %1$s of %2$s. To repair the rest, import their recovery phrase.
A JSON backup file with several accounts made by an earlier version of SORA can be empty. If you rely on one, export your accounts again from Accounts.
Your wallet was updated. Here is what SORA checked.
Your wallet is locked with your PIN
Welcome to the new SORA Wallet
Not enough unlocked XOR for the network fee
%1$s is locked on the network, for example by staking or voting, and can\'t be sent.
An earlier transaction from this account is still being checked, so the claim was not sent. Please try again in a few minutes.

SORA could not confirm that the network received your claim. It is being checked. Please don\'t submit it again until the result is shown. This screen continues by itself once the claim is confirmed, and tells you if it was not. You can also close the app and come back later.

Your claim was submitted and the network has not confirmed it yet. Please don\'t submit it again. This screen continues by itself once the claim is confirmed. You can also close the app and come back later.
You already sent this action from this account, and the network has not confirmed it yet. If you send it again, it may be carried out twice. You can follow the first one in Activity.
An earlier one is still waiting
This account can\'t sign transactions on this phone right now, so nothing was sent and no fee was charged. Your keys were not changed and your funds are safe on the blockchain.

Your balance is no longer enough for this amount and the network fee, so nothing was sent and no fee was charged. An earlier transaction may have been confirmed in the meantime. Check your balance and change the amount.
SORA couldn\'t check these amounts and the network fee with the network just now, so nothing was sent and no fee was charged. Check your internet connection and try again.
The network fee changed while you were reviewing. Nothing was sent. Check the new fee and confirm again.
This account can\'t pay the network fee right now, because the XOR it would be paid from is locked on the network, for example by staking or voting. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged.
This transaction couldn\'t be prepared. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged. Please try again.

SORA can\'t read this account\'s signing key on this phone, so nothing was sent and no fee was charged. Trying again won\'t change this. Your funds are safe on the blockchain, and nothing on this phone was changed. To sign with this account again, you need its recovery phrase or backup.

The SORA network was upgraded, and this version of the app can\'t prepare transactions for it yet. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged. Please update the app and try again. Your funds are safe on the blockchain.
SORA couldn\'t reach the network to prepare this transaction. Nothing was sent. Check your internet connection and try again.
The network processed this transaction and it failed. It did not move any funds. The network fee was charged.
The network did not include this transaction before it expired. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged. You can try again.
SORA couldn\'t connect to the SORA network, so this transaction never left your phone. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged. Check your internet connection and try again.
The network was too busy to take this transaction. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged. Please try again in a moment.

The network did not accept this transaction because the account can\'t pay the network fee right now. Some of your XOR may be locked, for example by staking or voting. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged.
The network checked this transaction and did not accept it. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged.
SORA could not confirm that the network received this transaction. It is being checked, and the status here and in Activity updates by itself. Please don\'t send it again until the result is shown.
Submitted. The network has not confirmed it yet; this usually takes less than a minute. Please don\'t send it again. The status here and in Activity updates by itself.
SORA couldn\'t read this pool from the network, so the amounts can\'t be checked right now. Nothing was sent. Check your internet connection and try again.
The network did not accept this transaction
This screen needs the SORA network to check fees, and it can\'t be reached right now. Check your internet connection and try again. Your funds are safe on the blockchain.
Assets could not be loaded. Check your connection, then reopen Swap.
Price history needs at least two dated observations.
Yes probability: %1$s at %2$s, %3$s at %4$s. Range %5$s to %6$s.
Google backup could not connect. Try again, or use your recovery phrase.
Google backup is unavailable in this app build. You can create a wallet with a recovery phrase or import an existing wallet.
Encrypted session active. Waiting for a signature request…
The application closed the encrypted session
Session closed when the wallet left the foreground
This request cannot be opened. Check that the wallet is upgraded, the SORA 3 account is enabled, and the link came from a trusted app.
The signing request could not be declined safely
This IrohaConnect link is empty or incomplete
The approval request expired after two minutes
Signing stopped because the selected wallet identity changed or could not be verified
The secure IrohaConnect relay could not be established or was interrupted
The app can see this account address. Each signature request needs a separate review and your approval.
The application sent an invalid or replayed IrohaConnect message
Set a device screen lock or an enrolled strong biometric before approving IrohaConnect requests
Website not provided by this app
Pairing failed because the selected wallet identity could not be reverified
Encrypted relay ready. Waiting for the application identity…
Review the application, network, account, and requested access
Review the exact signature scope. Pairing alone never signs.
The app was told that signing failed
A signature can authorize actions in the requesting app. Read the entire message and sign only if you understand and agree with its meaning.
Signature returned over the encrypted session
Reverifying the SORA 3 key and producing one signature…
Transaction requests that this wallet cannot interpret will be blocked.
This message cannot be shown completely and clearly. Signing is blocked. Ask the app for a readable text request.
This wallet cannot show the actions, recipients, amounts, or fees in this transaction. Signing is blocked. Return to the app and use a supported transaction flow.
Verifying the selected account and binding this encrypted session…
The active wallet changed, so the IrohaConnect session was closed
Create a wallet and keep its recovery phrase yourself.
Restore an encrypted backup from Google Drive, or create a wallet with a password-protected Google Drive backup.
Restore an existing wallet using its recovery phrase, key, or backup file.
Check the recipient address and make sure it belongs to the selected network.
Enter a valid amount greater than zero using the supported number of decimal places.
There are not enough available funds for this amount and the network fee. Adjust the amount or add funds.
The latest network information could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
The price or available balance has changed. Review a fresh quote before continuing.
This action is temporarily unavailable for this network. You can still receive funds and view activity.
This phone can\'t unlock the saved wallet data

The wallet data on this phone can\'t be unlocked here, for example because it was copied from another phone. Nothing was changed, and your funds are safe on the blockchain. Close and reopen the app to see your recovery options, or contact support.
Vertical axis: quoted price from 0 to 1
Showing saved markets. Connect to the network to check current prices.
Your transfer has been submitted. Its status will update in Activity. Do not send it again while confirmation is pending.
Wallet data kept on this phone

Choose an earlier set of wallet data. Your current wallets will be kept here too. The app will restart and check the selected data before opening it. Full wallet data uses its original PIN; an account database alone keeps your current PIN.
Keep your current wallet data and use this earlier set? You can return to the current set from this same screen.
The wallet data cannot be checked right now. Everything has been kept. Try again after restarting the app.
Some saved wallet data could not be verified. All files remain on this phone. Other verified choices are shown below.
Set a screen lock on this phone before switching wallet data.
Use this earlier account database? Your current database will be kept. Keys, backups and your current SORA PIN stay unchanged. The app will restart and verify every account before use.
Only send assets on %1$s to this address.
Each network has its own address. Share the address of the network the sender uses.
I have a recovery phrase or a working backup for every wallet on this phone.
Check the recipient and network before sending.
Camera access is unavailable. Paste the recipient address, or enable Camera in Settings.
Sending on %1$s starts when the network launches.
The recipient needs an address on the network you choose.
Sending on %1$s is paused right now.
The transfer was not completed. Check Activity before trying again.
The network has not confirmed the outcome. Check Activity before sending again to avoid a duplicate transfer.
Reverse the tokens you pay and receive
Your transfer is awaiting confirmation. Follow its progress in Activity.
